title: Reproducibility Artifact for Held-Out Validation of Product-Address-Aware Radix Selection for Closed Logarithmic Transformer Arithmetic
description: Portable Compiled Experiment replay for a preregistered held-out test of empirical product-address-aware radix selection in closed logarithmic transformer arithmetic. A clean full-from-model reproduction and the bundled offline replay both reproduce the frozen negative result: decision kill, zero of four validated pairs. The primary compiled artifact is content-addressed by SHA-256 25612d81a480dd5f8148a0dc247db58cb2fd719fe619e75ef0cd4945b3c1364b.
